_about: The starting stalls kit (tools/blender/build_stalls.py). Sizes in metres, in the glTF's axes: x along the row (stall numbers rise with x), y up, the horses break out towards +z. Every node's origin is on the front line at ground level. A unit is: stall_tower, then its bays one after another (stall_bay from x 0 to pitch, partition on its left edge), closed by stall_partition at the last bay's right edge, then the next stall_tower. Gates hang on the bay's posts: stall_gate_left at x partition/2 from the bay's left edge, stall_gate_right at pitch - partition/2; open = left turns -openDegrees about y, right +openDegrees.

horseStandsAt.note: where a horse's middle stands, metres behind the front line (its nose just behind the gates)
